accounts.name: winner
docs: so program-owned wallets (e.g. Squads) can receive. May be marked signer by the
client when sent through the relayer.

accounts.name: winner_ata
docs: Must already exist (Q-10) — otherwise use claim_token_with_ata.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ATA rent — usually the player (F3), may be anyone (crank / platform).

accounts.name: mint
docs: mut: burning strays reduces supply.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: Exists already (platform-core creates it at allow_mint — X3). Never init here.

accounts.name: game_authority
docs: The game's PDA signer (CPI) and rent payer (Q-13). System-owned, holds SOL.

accounts.name: allowed_mint
docs: F5: base mint must be allowlisted (extension filter + Treasury ATA exist).

accounts.name: base_source
docs: ATA of game_authority — re-creatable at the same address, so return_base always works.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Anchor `init` + `token::` — sized for the mint's required account extensions and
tolerant of a pre-funded address (POC §13 #3).

types.name: GameEntry
docs: PDA `[GAME_SEED, game_program]`. Never closed (I4) — only `Suspended`.
Layout: specs/designs/01 §4 (220 bytes).

types.name: GameStatus
docs: ⚠️ Never reorder — the relayer filters `GameEntry` with memcmp(offset 10, 0x00 = Active).
⚠️ INVARIANT: every explicit value MUST equal its variant index. The IDL carries no
discriminant values, so `declare_program!` consumers encode the *index*; a gap or
out-of-order value would silently desync them. Append only, next value = next index
(guarded by `enum_bytes_frozen_v1` + `enum_byte_equals_declaration_index` and the
compile-time `enum_tripwire` in tests/test_layout.rs).

types.name: PlatformConfig
docs: PDA `[CONFIG_SEED]` — single instance. Layout: specs/designs/01 §2 (97 bytes).
No `max_fee_bps` (X1 — ceiling is `MAX_FEE_BPS` in code), no `treasury`
(X2 — derive from `TREASURY_SEED`), no `moderator` (rev 3 #5 — RBAC role).
